name: Gregg Smith
residence: North Cheyenne, Laramie County (moved to Cheyenne in 2005; 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
education: Bachelor's degree in marketing and an M.B.A. in operations and project management (institutions not named in the 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
military: About 7½ years in the U.S. Army; he wrote that he left because of injury (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: Gregg Smith withdrew from the 2024 Republican primary for Senate District 4. In his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire he wrote that he lived in north Cheyenne, had lived in his then-current residence three years, had moved to Cheyenne in 2005 after leaving the Army, was born in Eugene, Oregon, and would be 51 on Election Day 2024.

He wrote that he has a bachelor's degree in marketing and an M.B.A. in operations and project management (he did not name the institutions), served about 7½ years in the Army before leaving because of injury, and had also taught at the community level in Wyoming. No more specific current occupation was given in the questionnaire.
